Fact.Name: DC first-time homebuyer credit carryforward from 2024 (Form 8859 line 1)
Fact.Description:
Form 8859 line 1: "Credit carryforward from 2024. Enter the amount from line 4 of your 2024 Form 8859." Integer cents; Min 0. Optional — absent means no Form 8859 and no Schedule 3 line 6h, which is every return this dictionary has ever resolved.
THERE IS NO CURRENT-YEAR ORIGINATION AND THAT IS THE FORM'S OWN CAUTION, not a scope choice: "You may claim only a carryforward of any unused credit (which is shown on your prior year Form 8859, line 4)." The original credit — the smaller of $5,000 ($2,500 MFS) and the purchase price, phased out from $70,000 of modified AGI ($110,000 MFJ) — is printed on the form as HISTORY, for a purchase that had to happen before 2012. So this writable is a prior-year figure the single-year fact graph cannot derive, exactly like form8396:/writablePriorYearMortgageCreditCarryforward, and it is the only input the form has. Line 4 is computed by /form8859CreditCarryforwardTo2026; it is not an unmodeled part of this form.

Fact.Name: Return has a Form 8859 input
Fact.Description:
True when the Form 8859 carryforward is answered. Gates /dcFirstTimeHomebuyerCredit so a return with no Form 8859 takes the else-0 branch WITHOUT evaluating the Tax Liability Limit Worksheet chain — the branch-gate pattern, which is what keeps Schedule 3 line 6h, /line8OfSchedule3 and total tax byte-identical on scenarios whose credit facts are Placeholder or Incomplete.
It is ALSO the fourth limb of ctcOdc:/isCompletingCreditLimitWorksheetB, which is half of what this fill closes: Credit Limit Worksheet A line 3's trigger names "the District of Columbia first-time homebuyer credit, Form 8859" among the four credits that send a filer to Worksheet B, and that limb could not be evaluated before this module existed. This fact is the module's INPUT gate, never its credit value — the same shape as form8396:/mortgageInterestCreditIsActive, form8839:/adoptionCreditIsActive and form5695:/residentialCleanEnergyPartIIsActive, and for the same reason: the trigger asks whether the filer is CLAIMING the credit, which is answered before any limit is applied.

Fact.Name: Form 8859 Tax Liability Limit Worksheet line 2 (credits ordered before this credit)
Fact.Description:
Tax Liability Limit Worksheet—Line 2, worksheet line 2: the total of the credits taken on the 2025 return that are applied against tax BEFORE the DC first-time homebuyer credit carryforward. The printed list, in the printed order: Schedule 3 line 6l; the foreign tax credit (line 1); the credit for child and dependent care expenses (line 2); the credit for the elderly or the disabled (line 6d); nonrefundable education credits (line 3); the retirement savings contributions credit (line 4); the energy efficient home improvement credit (line 5b); the credit for previously owned clean vehicles (line 6m); the clean vehicle credit (line 6f); the child tax credit or credit for other dependents (Form 1040 line 19, asterisked); the mortgage interest credit (line 6g); and the adoption credit (line 6c).
WHAT IS NOT ON THE LIST IS AS LOAD-BEARING AS WHAT IS: Schedule 3 line 5a, the residential clean energy credit, is absent — 6h is ordered BEFORE 5a, and Form 5695's own Part I limit worksheet confirms it from the other side by carrying a 6h term this one does not carry a 5a term for. Line 6h itself is absent too, as every self-referential worksheet's list is. Non-circular by the same argument the three sibling worksheets make: none of these twelve terms depends on /sched3Line6h.
THE CTC/ODC TERM CARRIES THE "only if allowed and taken" IsComplete GATE the worksheet's own Note directs, the same wrapper the Form 5695, Form 8396 and Form 8839 worksheets use, so a return whose dependent-credit facts are Incomplete enters 0 rather than propagating Incompleteness into Schedule 3 line 6h and total tax.

Fact.Name: Form 8859 Tax Liability Limit Worksheet line 2 — the Credit Limit Worksheet B twin
Fact.Description:
/form8859TaxLiabilityLimitWorksheetLine2 with THREE substitutions, all of them forced by the fact that this form is ordered LAST of the four Worksheet-B credits:
(1) the Form 1040 line 19 (CTC/ODC) term becomes ctcOdc:/sched8812CreditLimitWorksheetBLine14 — that is the asterisk footnote printed at the foot of Form 8859's own page, in the same words as on Forms 8396, 8839 and 5695; (2) the Schedule 3 line 6g term becomes form8396:/mortgageInterestCreditWsb; (3) the Schedule 3 line 6c term becomes form8839:/nonrefundableAdoptionCreditWsb.
SUBSTITUTIONS (2) AND (3) ARE THE PART THAT IS EASY TO GET WRONG, and form8839's own Worksheet-B twin is the precedent: a Worksheet-B filer's Form 8396 and Form 8839 are themselves figured under the same footnote, so reading the PUBLIC /sched3Line6g and /sched3Line6c here would (a) be tax-wrong, because those selectors would hand back the Worksheet-B values anyway on a trigger-true return and the plain values on a trigger-false one — the wrong number in the one case this arm exists for — and (b) be mechanically a cycle, because the public selectors read ctcOdc:/isCompletingCreditLimitWorksheetB, which this arm is upstream of through worksheet line 15. The twins are pure "what would the credit be under the Worksheet B ordering" facts and are downstream of nothing here.
Every other term is the same fact in the same order as the plain arm.

Fact.Name: Limitation based on tax liability (Form 8859 line 2)
Fact.Description: Form 8859 line 2, from the Tax Liability Limit Worksheet: worksheet line 1 (the tax liability before the application of credits, Form 1040 line 18, taxCalculations /totalTentativeTax) minus worksheet line 2 (/form8859TaxLiabilityLimitWorksheetLine2), floored at 0 — "If zero or less, enter -0- here and on Form 8859, lines 2 and 3".

Fact.Name: Limitation based on tax liability (Form 8859 line 2) — the Credit Limit Worksheet B twin
Fact.Description: /form8859TaxLiabilityLimit computed from /form8859TaxLiabilityLimitWorksheetLine2Wsb: Form 1040 line 18 minus the worksheet's line 2 with the three Worksheet-B substitutions, floored at 0. Identical shape to the plain arm; only the subtrahend differs.

Fact.Name: DC first-time homebuyer credit — the Credit Limit Worksheet B twin (Form 8859 line 3)
Fact.Description:
Form 8859 line 3 computed on the Worksheet B arm: the smaller of line 1 (the carryforward) and the twin line-2 limit. This is the value Credit Limit Worksheet B line 15 takes for Schedule 3 line 6h, and it is the value the public /dcFirstTimeHomebuyerCredit selects when the filer is completing Worksheet B.
IT IS NOT ITSELF GATED ON THE TRIGGER, deliberately, exactly as form8396:/mortgageInterestCreditWsb is not: the selector below owns that choice, so this fact stays a pure "what would the credit be under the Worksheet B ordering" and can be read by ctcOdc's worksheet line 15 without the selector — and therefore without the trigger, and therefore without a cycle — appearing anywhere in its cone. It IS gated on the input, so a return with no Form 8859 resolves 0 without evaluating the limit chain.

Fact.Name: DC first-time homebuyer credit carryforward (Form 8859 line 3 → Schedule 3 line 6h)
Fact.Description:
Form 8859 line 3 = the smaller of line 1 (the carryforward) and line 2 (the tax liability limit), "Include this amount on Schedule 3 (Form 1040), line 6h". Nonrefundable.
A SELECTOR OVER TWO ARMS, and the arm order is the whole point — the shape all three sibling bridge credits already have. The FIRST Case asks ctcOdc:/isCompletingCreditLimitWorksheetB — Credit Limit Worksheet A line 3's trigger — and returns /dcFirstTimeHomebuyerCreditWsb, the twin whose line-2 limit subtracts Credit Limit Worksheet B line 14 in place of Form 1040 line 19 (and the 6g/6c twins in place of the public lines). The remaining Cases are the plain arm. So this fact is strictly DOWNSTREAM of both arms and neither arm is downstream of it; ctcOdc's worksheet line 15 reads the TWIN, never this path, which is what keeps /sched8812CreditLimit acyclic.
COMPLETE-SAFE: with no Form 8859 input the else branch yields 0 WITHOUT evaluating either limit chain, so every prior scenario keeps /sched3Line6h (new, and 0 everywhere), /line8OfSchedule3 and total tax byte-identical.
THE REGRESSION NET CANNOT VALIDATE EITHER ARM and that is stated rather than discovered: no committed scenario answers the carryforward, and the Worksheet-B population across the baseline corpus is empty. tests/nodes/ty2025/form8859/* are the entire evidence surface.

Fact.Name: DC first-time homebuyer credit carryforward to 2026 (Form 8859 line 4)
Fact.Description: Form 8859 line 4 = line 1 minus line 3: the part of the 2024 carryforward that this year's tax liability limit left unused, which the filer carries to 2026. No floor is needed because line 3 is a LesserOf against line 1, so the difference can never be negative. It is the figure next year's Form 8859 line 1 transcribes, and the only Part of this form the graph did not yet compute.

Fact.Name: Form 8859 line 2 as printed: the limitation based on tax liability on whichever arm applies
Fact.Description: Form 8859 line 2, which is also line 3 of the Tax Liability Limit Worksheet printed below the form: the tax liability limit on the District of Columbia first time homebuyer credit carryforward. The dictionary computes it twice, /form8859TaxLiabilityLimit on the plain Form 1040 line 19 path and /form8859TaxLiabilityLimitWsb on the Credit Limit Worksheet B path. This fact is the printed value, selected by ctcOdc:/isCompletingCreditLimitWorksheetB, the same selector /dcFirstTimeHomebuyerCredit already applies one line below.

Fact.Name: Form 8859 Tax Liability Limit Worksheet line 2 as printed
Fact.Description: The Form 8859 Tax Liability Limit Worksheet line 2 total of the credits and adjustments ordered ahead of the District of Columbia first time homebuyer credit. The dictionary computes it twice: the plain arm reads Form 1040 line 19 (/form8859TaxLiabilityLimitWorksheetLine2) and the Worksheet B arm reads Credit Limit Worksheet B line 14 in its place (/form8859TaxLiabilityLimitWorksheetLine2Wsb), which is what the asterisk footnote printed under the worksheet directs. This fact is the printed value, selected by ctcOdc:/isCompletingCreditLimitWorksheetB.
